text:
Asha: Heads-up, NovaCare POC hit repeated 429s during a live chat demo just now.
Mike: What endpoint were they on? chat.completions? streaming?
Asha: Streaming chat. SE had 6 reps each running 2 live sessions to show multi-user behavior. We saw errors ~90s in.
Priya: Any headers or body of error?
Asha: Screenshot from customer: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 40  # concurrent streams per-tenant
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 24
Retry-After: 15
Request-ID: rwd-req-cc33f
```
Mike: Ah, this is a concurrent-streams cap (we have explicit per-tenant concurrency SLO for streaming chat). They exceeded 40 streams.
Rohan: Why does header show 40? I thought default was 50 for demo tenants.
Priya: Checking tenant config now...
Priya: Config says `streaming_concurrent_limit: 40` for nova-care-poc. Looks like sales created a smaller sandbox earlier.
Asha: Sales notes: we promised them "multiplayer sessions" during the walkthrough, so this mismatch is embarrassing. They asked if we can raise it for demo and also asked about cost implications.
Mike: Quick mitigation: ask them to close idle tabs and reduce reps per VM to 1 until we can bump. Longer: temporary override or increase for the POC.
Rohan: I can apply a short override for 12 hours. We log it for audit/billing. Command: 
```
redwood-admin quotas adjust --tenant nova-care-poc --route chat.streaming --concurrent-streams 120 --expires 12h --note "POC demo bump requested by AE"
```
Asha: Can you also confirm whether streaming concurrency counts by open websocket connections or by active token exchange threads? They had some long-idle streams that still counted.
Mike: It counts open connections, not just active msg exchanges. Idle sockets = used slot.
Priya: Customer was using the hosted demo UI which keeps sockets open during the demo. For long demos we should recommend reconnect behavior or keepalive policy that frees slots after X idle seconds.
Asha: Sales asks whether this bump will change billing. We need a simple explanation for the AE to share with customer.
billing-bot: billing-note: tenant=nova-care-poc override=concurrent_streams increased from=40 to=120 expires_in=12h note="POC demo bump" request_id=rwd-bill-101
Priya: Short answer: concurrency bump doesn't directly change per-token billing, but it increases peak capacity which could increase cost if they actually use more tokens. Recommend we tell them: "No change to per-token rates; this is a temporary capacity increase for demo only."
Rohan: Applying override now...
deploy-bot: quota-change: tenant=nova-care-poc route=chat.streaming old=40 new=120 by=Rohan expires_in=12h note="POC demo bump" request_id=rwd-admin-88a
Rohan: Done. Control plane push succeeded, regional gateways received new config. Should be immediate.
Asha: Customer retried and the demo completed with 10 concurrent streams, no 429s. Thank you.
Mike: Action items: 1) Sales POC onboarding checklist should validate tenant streaming limit and recommend keepalive/idle timeout, 2) SDK demo UI should surface current streaming cap, 3) Add a small help blurb in demo playbook about billing implications.
Priya: Filing infra ticket: INFRA-4902 "Expose per-tenant streaming concurrency in demo console" and assigning to eng-telemetry.
Asha: One more ask from customer: security questionnaire flagged "session lifecycle" for streaming sockets. Can we provide a short blurb on how we expire idle sockets?
Mike: I'll draft standard language: we enforce per-tenant idle timeout (configurable), can close sockets after N seconds of inactivity, and log connection open/close events for audit. Pass to Legal if they want official language.
Asha: Great. I'll loop in Legal with the draft. Closing thread after tickets created. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
